decisions.rationale: Paystub gross pay and YTD are unreadable (fax degraded), so a key figure cannot be read with confidence; AR-03 requires not_satisfied and a clearer copy. NOA 2025 (67,279.66) alone is not enough.

History Jun 6-Sep 10 = 96 days; required = 66,500 + 9,975 = 76,475, balance 96,171.20. 30,500 gift is from a cousin, not immediate family (AR-07), so needs_review. Letter otherwise has donor, amount, non-repayable statement and signature.
Employment letter dated June 30, 2026 is 75 days old at review date 2026-09-13, over the 30-day limit (AR-04); no recent letter on file.
